**All seven landed, and the three things both critics called closed are open.** `content` takes a url, all seven words can be saved by both editors, and a page you made draws its own children wherever it is drawn.

![A page I made an hour ago, running inside the blog preset - its OWN tabs, and its name is a link](shots/nested-made-page-1280.png)

**1 - A nested made page draws its own children and blocks, fixed at the seam.** `stage_props(node, { page, url_of })` in `stage.js` is now the ONE translation from a saved `page.json` to a stage, and both callers use it - the page you open, and the page nested inside another. `/library/blog-post/?nest=/imagine/paging/make/notes/` reads **Today, Later** with `/make/notes/today/` and `/make/notes/later/` as real links; it read Overview/Pricing/Docs/Contact. There is no third level because there is only one function. It also turned up the same defect with an *empty* list: `made/ideas/` has no children and was listing four strangers - it says "No pages under this one yet" now.

**2 - All seven words savable.** `stage.js` grew one hook: **`changed` tells, `keep` writes** - two hooks because the bar already owned `changed`. It runs before the address is written, so saving a word leaves the url clean. On `/make/notes/` I set **room** and **type size** from the bar; `made/notes/page.json` said `wide`/`display` within the second and **a bare reload came back wide and display**. Build's middle now wears the realm's own bar (all seven controls) and writes straight into the node. `room` and `type size` were set by no editor at all before this.

**3 - `content` takes a url, cold, both kinds.** `?content=/notes/auth/readme.md` renders 11,027 characters of that markdown in the box; `?content=/imagine/paging/make/notes/` **runs the made page** in it, tab strip and child links included - the same code path as `?nest=`. The dropdown keeps its eight and gains *A page or file...*, which reveals a field.

![Blocks and the content word compose - the block, the line naming what is under it, then the card wall](shots/made-page-block-1280.png)

**4-7.** Blocks and `content` **compose** instead of one silently switching the other off, and `made/ideas/` ships a block so the case exists. Build's step 7 moved to a row across the whole card - **957px wide on a 957px line**, where it was 230px holding 701 - and both code boxes got **Copy**. **[Expand](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/expand/) expands**: it is a navigation word now, drawn as `<details>` wearing `ui/accordion`'s hairline, so there is no JavaScript in the gesture - opening a row grows the box **+138px** at 1280 and **+165px** at 3440, closing takes exactly that back, and the address never changes. Then all eight small ones: the dead renderer deleted, the docs that still taught `kids`/`mech`/`width: large` rewritten to the seven words, Build's step 3 reading *Content colour* off `CONTROLS`, the four action buttons off `.paging-chip.on`, Cross saying it scrolls, Make's duplicated sentence said once, the nest band's name a link, and a **skip link**: focus it, press Enter, and the *next* Tab is the bar - two presses instead of forty-five.

**Proof.** 68 urls x 400/1280/1920/3440 = **272 cold loads, zero page errors** and zero sideways scroll, the known `readme/page.js` probe 404 the only console line. Every gesture above was driven headless and measured.

**Left, deliberately:** Cross gets a sentence rather than an edge fade (a fade over a wall of live pages dims the cells it is advertising), and the drawer's form names a url `content` in its sentence rather than offering a second field for it - the bar is the editor, the drawer explains. A nesting **loop fuse** was needed and added: the bar on a made page can save `content` = its own address, which would read itself for ever, so two levels draw and the third hands over a link.
